verdict.rationale: The official docs state a-Shell is entirely open source under the FreeBSD license, and its source is hosted in a public GitHub repository (holzschu/a-shell), so a user can read it under an open license. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the license terms (e.g. a LICENSE file excerpt from the repo) rather than only the project site's claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: a-Shell is entirely OpenSource, and released under the FreeBSD license.
The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
